# Allergic Conjunctivitis Management: Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

#### Andrea Leonardi1 · Luigi Quintieri2 · Ignacio Jáuregui Presa3 · Jesús Merayo LLoves4 · Jesús Montero5,6 · José Manuel Benítez‑del‑Castillo7 · Francisco Javier Seoane Lestón8 · Eloína González‑Mancebo9 · Riccardo Asero10 · Anna Groblewska11 · Piotr Kuna12

Accepted: 13 May 2024 / Published online: 13 June 2024 © The Author(s) 2024

Abstract Purpose of Review The aim of this review, is to present an updated revision of topical management of SAC and PAC, based on the available scientific evidence and focused on the impact of ophthalmic solution formulations on eye surface.

chunks.text: Summary Seasonal and perennial allergic conjunctivitis (SAC and PAC) are the most frequent causes of ocular allergy (OA), and both conditions are underdiagnosed and undertreated.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0002

chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The additional tear film disruption caused by the release of inflammatory mediators increases and exacerbates the impact of signs and symptoms and may trigger damage of the ocular surface.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0004
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Comorbidities are frequent, and dry eye disease in particular must be considered.

chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

## Introduction

Ocular allergy (OA) is a common immunological inflammatory process of the anterior surface of the eye [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0007
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In fact, OA represents a collection of underestimated diseases of the eye observed in children and adults that present with a wide spectrum of clinical forms [2].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0008

most frequent sensitization in PAC; food allergens may also occasionally cause ocular symptoms [1, 3].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0013
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: AC is associated with an immunoglobulin E (IgE)-mediated mechanism also referred to as Th2-mediated inflammation [2, 4, 5].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0014
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The prevalence of OA has been increasing worldwide for several decades [6].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0015
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: SAC and PAC can affect between 14% and up to 45% of the general population, depending on geographical region [6].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0016
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: However, AC is an often underdiagnosed and undertreated health problem, with only 10% of patients with AC symptoms seeking medical attention: most sufferers manage their condition with over-the-counter (OTC) medications and complementary, non-pharmacological remedies [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0017
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: SAC is by far the most common form of OA, representing over half of all cases [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0018
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Furthermore, OA commonly overlaps with other ocular disease disorders, including infections and dry eye disease (DED) [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0019
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: OA also has a significant impact on quality of life (QoL) and carries a high economic burden [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0020
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Successful management of OA involves preventive, nonpharmacological, and pharmacological measures [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0021
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Over the years, various therapeutic options have been developed to achieve symptom control.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0022
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: First-line options are topical antihistamines, mast cell stabilizers, and dual-acting agents, while corticosteroids and immunomodulators are reserved for severe cases of keratoconjunctivitis [4, 5, 8].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0023
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: It should be kept in mind that many patients with OA are treated with topical treatments over long periods of time [7] and, therefore, the short- and long-term safety and tolerability of products used to treat the eye surface are paramount.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0024
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: OA is treated by general practitioners, allergists, and ophthalmologists, and all these professionals should be aware of the benefits and potential harms of the products prescribed.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0025
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: For instance, some compounds found in ophthalmic solutions may induce damage to the ocular surface by the disruption of epithelial barrier of tear film, which can lead to other diseases such as dry eye, or could exacerbate SAC and PAC [8, 9].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0026
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The purpose of this review is to present updated information on the management of OA for healthcare providers seeing these patients, with a particular focus on topical treatments for SAC and PAC.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0027
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
## Problems Associated with Allergic Conjunctivitis

### Tear Film Disruption

Epithelial barrier dysfunction is a hallmark feature of several ocular allergic disorders [8] and tear film alterations are often observed in patients with AC.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0028
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The eye presents some physiological barriers, including complex junctions in conjunctival and corneal epithelium [8] that help it act as a physical and immune barrier, preventing the entrance of pathogens and allergens and helping maintain tissue homeostasis.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0029
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In AC, allergens with intrinsic proteolytic activity cross the conjunctival epithelium and enter the submucosal space, where they interact with dendritic and conjunctival mast cells to induce allergic inflammation with activation of inflammatory cytokines such as interleukin 33 (IL-33), thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP), and transforming growth factor (TGF)-β [8].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0030
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The disrupted corneal epithelium can also release neuromediators, including substance P (SP), calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP), and nerve growth factor (NGF) [8].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0031
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: These soluble mediators activate dendritic cells (DC) to generate a typical Th2 lymphocyte response in SAC and PAC [2].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0032
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The subsequent sensitization and activation of adaptive immune response leads to type 2 inflammation characteristic of the allergic disorders.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0033
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In SAC and PAC, exposure of sensitized patients to the allergen results in a type I IgE-mediated allergic reaction, that provokes mast cell degranulation and the immediate release of histamine.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0034
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Overexpression of Th2-associated cytokines (IL4, IL-5, IL-13) and histamine contribute to long-term conjunctival epithelial metaplasia, disruption of the corneal epithelium and stimulation of goblet cell secretion, which could modify the tear film [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0035
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In addition to the impact of AC on ocular surface, some of ophthalmic solutions for its treatment frequently contain compounds and preservatives that may contribute to the disruption of epithelial barrier of tear film [8, 9].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0036
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The most common preservative is benzalkonium chloride (BAK), and its impact on the ocular surface has been extensively studied [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0037
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: BAK is a detergent [11] that disrupts the tear film and damages the epithelial barrier, exerting a pro-inflammatory action through activation of the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kB) pathway [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0038
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In vitro studies and murine models [12, 13] suggest that prolonged exposure to BAK leads to ocular damage due to a loss of immune tolerance of the conjunctival epithelium of the eye.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0039
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The pathophysiology of AC is complex, and the condition is often accompanied by other problems than should be borne in mind during treatment, such as tear film disruption and concomitant disorders.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0040
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Awareness of these aspects will help decision-making.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0041
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Concomitant Pathologies and Differential Diagnosis

Allergic conjunctivitis is often comorbid with allergic rhinitis (AR) [14].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0042
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
The two disorders are so strongly and frequently associated that they are defined in most countries as

a single condition (e.g., allergic rhinoconjunctivitis) [15].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0043
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: When this happens, conjunctival symptoms are often perceived by clinicians or even patients as a minor problem, and therefore ocular manifestations are frequently misdiagnosed or underdiagnosed, and not properly managed [1, 16] or sub-optimally treated [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0044
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Therefore, when compared to AR, allergic conjunctivitis receives far less attention [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0045
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In many countries, most cases are diagnosed and managed by a general practitioner and rarely referred to specialists, even when other signs and symptoms suggest a systemic allergic disorder that would be more appropriately treated by a specialist [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0046
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Notably, the therapeutic approach of primary care physicians and eye care specialists has been discordant [1], and this is also true for allergists.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0047
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In this regard, a common knowledge base such as that provided by this review may be useful to detect areas for improvement.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0048
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: DED and AC coexist and show a significant clinical overlap.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0049
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In fact, AC and DED are the most common ocular surface disorders, and they both have a potentially severe impact on patients’ QoL [15].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0050
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Bearing DED in mind is crucial when assessing AC as they can both be considered as conditions that predispose to or at least facilitate each other [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0051
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Eye itching, conjunctival redness and tear film dysfunction have been detected in both conditions, thus complicating differential diagnosis [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0052
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In addition, the prolonged use of some topical and systemic medications, especially eye drop formulations containing BAK as a preservative, can contribute to the development of DED.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0053
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The diagnosis of AC is based on clinical history, signs and symptoms, and confirmed with in vivo and in vitro allergen testing [16].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0054
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: An exhaustive ocular examination to assess abnormalities of the conjunctiva, cornea, and tear film, together with collection of the patient’s clinical history should always be the first steps.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0055
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Allergen-specific IgE response should be ascertained: the skin prick test (SPT), along with in vitro specific IgE measurement, is still considered the gold standard for this, although if the relationship between allergen exposure and ocular signs and symptoms is not clear, a conjunctival allergen provocation test may also be performed [1, 17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0056
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Over‑the‑counter Medications

One important problem is that patients with ocular allergic disease often self-medicate; they purchase OTC medications and fail to seek help even when those therapies are ineffective [22, 23].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0057
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In one study [18], self-treatment measures were the first step taken by 56% of patients diagnosed with AC.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0058
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Many OTC drugs are topical vasoconstrictors or decongestants that have limited efficacy in OA, as they do not treat the underlying cause of the disease [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0059
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Conversely, the use and overuse of OTC products may lead to adverse effects such as rebound vasodilation [23].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0060
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
Furthermore, BAK is a very

common preservative in these solutions – present in over 70% of OTC eye drops – that, as mentioned, has the potential to induce ocular toxicity and exacerbate ocular surface damage [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0061
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: ## Is There Room for Improvement in the Management of AC?
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0062
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: AC continues to be an underdiagnosed and undertreated disease [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0063
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Considering the need for differential diagnosis, a multidisciplinary approach involving allergists, general practitioners, otolaryngologists, and eye care specialists is advisable [1, 17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0064
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: It should be borne in mind that in many settings, allergic conjunctivitis patients are often seen in primary care and, when referred to a specialist, those with SAC symptoms are usually referred to the allergist, while patients with PAC are more often referred to the ophthalmologist for differential diagnosis [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0065
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Therefore, inter-consultation channels or appropriate cross-referral between specialists (allergists and eye care specialists) is advisable, as fluent communication between disciplines would optimize patient care and improve outcomes [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0066
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Finally, it is necessary to increase understanding and awareness about the impact of preservatives and other potentially harmful compounds in ophthalmic topical treatments.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0067
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Anti-allergic eye drops that maintain ocular surface homeostasis while avoiding the toxic effects of preservatives should be considered as standard of care, especially if long-term treatment is expected.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0068
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
## Update on Topical Pharmacological Treatment

The recommended management approach for acute and chronic forms of OA starts with allergen identification, followed by non-pharmacological treatments (allergen avoidance and hygiene measures), progressing finally to pharmacological treatment [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0069
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Etiological treatment with various forms of immunotherapy can be offered under the guidance of specialists [1, 19]; when specific sensitization is the main cause of ocular allergy, allergen immunotherapy should be considered, as it has shown to be effective in reducing total and individual ocular symptoms of SAC and PAC [1, 17, 19].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0070
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The aim of pharmacological treatment in OA is to provide control and relief of signs and symptoms [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0071
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: According to guidelines and consensus documents, topical antihistamines, mast cell stabilizers or double-action drugs should be the first line of treatment for the management of SAC and PAC [1, 4, 17, 19].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0072
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Several studies have focused on the safety differences between these different topical treatment groups in terms of the potential damage on ocular surface or their role in the development of conditions such as DED [9, 20–23].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0073
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Summaries of the characteristics of approved products are listed in Tables 1 and 2.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0074
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: When symptoms of allergic rhinitis are present, treatment options usually include systemic antihistamines and intranasal corticosteroids [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0075
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In this scenario, the use of second-generation systemic antihistamines, with fewer adverse events and a much better profile in terms of sedation, is recommended [4, 5, 7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0076
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The potential of some systemic antihistamines to worsen the ocular surface due to their anticholinergic effect should be taken into account [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0077
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Systemic leukotriene receptor antagonists have proved to be useful in the treatment of allergic rhinitis, although less than oral antihistamines [17]; but they have a limited use for the treatment of OA [1, 24].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0078
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
Topical immunomodulators such

- as calcineurin inhibitors, cyclosporine and tacrolimus, are recommended for chronic diseases of OA (vernal or atopic keratoconjunctivitis) [1, 17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0079
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Their use depends on severity and frequency of exacerbations.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0080
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
Topical corticosteroids may


be used for severe forms of OA and in uncontrolled exacerbations of SAC and PAC since their use is associated with potentially significant adverse reactions [17, 25].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0081
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Topical non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) are not recommended for the treatment of SAC and PAC [17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0082
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Many patients also require the concomitant use of lubricating eye drops to maximize control of ocular allergy symptoms [26].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0083
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Finally, in patients with severe forms of SAC and PAC, following the recommendations of the EAACI guidelines, allergen immunotherapy (AIT) should be considered a therapeutic option [19].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0084
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: AIT is indicated when IgE-mediated hypersensitivity is evidenced, after first-line treatment failure, or to modify the natural course of ocular allergic disease.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0085
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Systemic immunosuppressive treatment and biologic therapy may be prescribed in severe forms of OA, such as refractory vernal or atopic keratoconjunctivitis [17].

chunks.text: This cetirizine ophthalmic formulation needs to be used three times a day, as the dosage is one drop in each affected eye every 8 h. It contains BAK (0.01%) as a preservative to guarantee the sterility of the multi-dose formulation.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0098
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: As for the newest bilastine ophthalmic solution, efficacy, tolerability, and efficacy of a once-daily administration have been evaluated in clinical trials to date [31, 35–39].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0099
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The bilastine formulation has shown a fast onset of action and efficacy for as long as 16 h post-administration, indicating that it is suitable for a once-daily dosing [31, 38].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0100
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In a phase three clinical trial, it also showed similar efficacy to a marketed multi-dose formulation of ketotifen 0.025% [35, 39].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0101
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: This newly EMA-approved bilastine formulation is a preservative-free solution co-formulated with hyaluronic acid, unique in its class, presented in a special multi-dose container.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0102
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Preclinical in vitro and in vivo studies have shown that these two characteristics (preservative-free with hyaluronic acid) help preserve the tear film and ocular surface integrity [31, 38].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0103
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Topical Mast Cell Stabilizers

The mechanism of action by which topical mast cell stabilizers inhibit mast cell degranulation remains unclear [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0104
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Available mast cell stabilizers include lodoxamide, nedocromil or sodium cromoglycate, and others.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0105
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: However, recent studies [7, 26] suggest that mast cell stabilizers are not as effective in treating ocular allergies because to achieve their maximum effect they need to be used as a prophylactic measure prior to allergen exposure, thus decreasing compliance and adherence as compared to other anti-allergic ophthalmic agents [26, 40].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0106
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Topical Dual‑Activity Agents

Topical dualactivity agents (antihistamine/mast cell stabilizing activity) have been well studied and are supported by extensive clinical experience [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0107
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
Although topical antihistamines and dual-activity agents are treated as a separate category in this article, recent publications include both antihistamines and these topical drugs in the same group, since

- at the conjunctival concentrations reached in direct topical use, almost all antihistamine eye drops also act as mast cell stabilizers to some extent [41, 42].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0108
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Examples of widely used topical dual-activity agents include azelastine, epinastine, ketotifen, olopatadine, alcaftadine, and bepotastine besilate (Tables 1 and 2).
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0109
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In terms of efficacy, olopatadine, ketotifen, alcaftadine and bepotastine have a similar efficacy profile [43, 44], although some studies reported that bepostatine and alcaftadine appear to be superior to olopatadine [45].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0110
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In the management of SAC, formulations containing ketotifen 0.025% have proven to be effective, although in a study that collected patient-reported measures of efficacy and comfort, patients preferred an olopatadine 0.1% solution [46].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0111
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Scientific evidence suggests that in terms of clinical relief and tolerability, dual-action agents are superior to antihistamines such as levocabastine [28] and mast cell stabilizers such as lodoxamide or cromolyn, although recent studies indicated that many have secondary effects, such as eosinophil migration inhibition and activation of cytokines and other inflammatory mediators [7].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0112
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Moreover, treatment with these therapeutic agents alone is usually not enough to control the condition [17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0113
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Most of the commercialized formulations containing so-called dual-action agents also include BAK, which may cause ocular surface toxicity.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0114
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In some European countries [47], preservative-free single-dose and multi-dose formulations containing ketotifen [47, 48], olopatadine [49] and azelastine [50] are available.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0115
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Topical Vasoconstrictors

Topical ophthalmic vasoconstrictors, such as naphazoline, oxymetazoline, phenylephrine, and tetrahydrozoline, are α-adrenergic agonists that relieve conjunctival reddening caused by vasodilation [4].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0116
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: They do not reduce the allergic response as they do not antagonize any of the mediators of the allergic reaction and inflammation, and instead only alleviate hyperaemia.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0117
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Prolonged use may cause rebound hyperaemia and tachyphylaxis and consequently, these products should be used with caution and only for short periods of time [1, 17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0118
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Topical Ophthalmic and Intranasal Corticosteroids

Topical ophthalmic corticosteroids are rarely needed for the treatment of SAC and PAC, but may be used in acute exacerbations as short, pulsed therapy [17]; particularly in severe forms of OA such as vernal or atopic keratoconjunctivitis.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0119
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The potency and duration of treatment should be clinically determined based on the severity of ocular inflammation and corneal involvement [17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0120
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Despite being the most effective anti-inflammatory drugs in clinical practice for OA [17], they are associated with a myriad of potentially severe adverse reactions (increased intraocular pressure, cataract development, delayed wound healing, and increased susceptibility to infection or superinfections), so their use must be closely monitored by an ophthalmologist, especially in long-term treatments.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0121
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: They should be limited to the most severe forms of OA and severe and uncontrolled exacerbations [1, 17, 51].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0122
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
Regarding intranasal corticosteroids, there is increasing evidence indicating that they are effective in reducing ocular symptoms associated with allergic rhinitis, so their use is

recommended in the presence of comorbidities [1, 7, 17].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0123
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Intranasal steroids such as fluticasone furoate and mometasone furoate have shown positive effects on ocular allergic symptoms as compared to placebo [7, 52].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0124
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Topical NSAIDs

NSAIDs block the cyclooxygenase enzyme and the conversion of arachidonic acid into prostaglandins, therefore reducing inflammation and signs and symptoms of AC.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0125
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Ketorolac was the first approved for OA; however, like other topical ophthalmic NSAIDs, it was associated with discomfort on instillation, possibly affecting patient compliance.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0126
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Topical ophthalmic NSAIDs are therefore not recommended for the management of SAC and PAC, due to significant irritation associated with instillation and other side effects, such as corneal melting and perforation.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0127
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: They are limited to the most severe forms of OA or for exacerbations that cannot be controlled by other measures, and always for as short a duration as possible [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0128
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
## Considerations when Selecting an Ophthalmic Formulation

### Presence of Preservatives

A recurring concern when designing an ophthalmic drug is the need to include preservative compounds in multi-dose formulations to provide antimicrobial activity and ensure sterility [53].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0129
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: It has been widely demonstrated that preservatives have a toxic effect on the ocular surface, and they lead to epithelium disruption and a tear film dysfunction [2, 8].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0130
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Many kinds and natures of preservatives are used in ophthalmic solutions, such as detergents (BAK), ionic buffers (propylene glycol), alcohols and parabens, among others.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0131
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Nevertheless, BAK, present in approximately 70% of ophthalmic formulations, is the most common.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0132
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The cytotoxic effects of BAK on ocular tissue cells have been extensively documented, and the estimated threshold at which toxicity occurs is at a concentration of 0.005% [53].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0133
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Multi-dose topical ophthalmic medications for the treatment of SAC and PAC containing BAK as a preservative usually exceed that threshold.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0134
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Until now, preservative-free ophthalmic solutions were most often available in single-use (single-dose dose) presentations [50, 54], although nowadays multi-dose presentations, azelastine [53, 55], ketotifen [48], olopatadine [49] and the new bilastine eye drop formulation are BAK-free (Table 1).
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0135
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Notably, the absence of preservatives in ophthalmic solutions has been shown to improve ex vivo corneal wound healing [56].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0136
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
So, taking all this into account, to minimize possible toxic effects on the ocular surface, recent guidelines [1, 2, 10, 17]

for the management of allergic conjunctivitis recommend preservative-free eye drops whenever possible.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0137
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Other excipients present in eye drop formulations may lead to allergic contact dermatitis and contribute to the development of other chronic diseases such as DED [10].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0138
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Some of these products are wool alcohols, thiomersal, and phosphate buffers.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0139
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Benefits of Hydration

The use of artificial tears with viscosity-enhancing agents such as hyaluronic acid (HA) to provide hydration and lubrication at the ocular surface has been shown to improve wound healing and to prevent dryness [56].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0140
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In this respect, HA has gained widespread use in eye surgeries and the treatment of eye disease, as HA-based materials are well tolerated and show excellent biocompatibility [56].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0141
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The main properties of HA are lubrication and water retention, which facilitate increasing corneal wettability in patients with DED [57].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0142
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Preclinical and clinical studies have shown that artificial tears containing HA provide acute and long-term therapeutic benefits in DED, including enhancement of corneal epithelium healing, improvement of the ocular surface function [58], normalization of clinical parameters, and alleviation and reduction of DED symptoms (hyperaemia, conjunctival redness and corneal wettability) [57, 59].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0143
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The combination of HA with active pharmaceutical compounds may also increase their bioavailability due to the high viscosity of HA [60], and its protective effect against conjunctival dehydration may provide benefits [61].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0144
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In conclusion, co-formulation with HA has potential benefits.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0145
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
### Product Features, Patient Preferences and Adherence

A real-life study revealed that daily treatment of OA and patients´ use of their treatment for OA barely conforms with guideline recommendations for its management.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0146
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Topical ocular decongestants and corticosteroids were used by most patients, independent of their diagnosis and OA severity [62].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0147
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Furthermore, patients often self-medicate with OTC preparations containing preservatives, including BAK, which may exacerbate ocular surface symptoms [7] and cause toxicity [8, 63].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0148
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Adherence to topical ophthalmic treatment in eye conditions has been widely studied.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0149
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Patient preference for an eye drop can often be a primary factor in determining the level of compliance and adherence to treatment [46].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0150
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Discomfort upon instillation (as produced by NSAIDs) and long regular dosing (as required for efficacy in treatment with mast cells stabilizers) are other causes that have been associated with a poorer treatment adherence [1].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0151
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
At present, there is a large market interest in preservative-free products,

particularly for patients who need daily eye drops for long periods.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0152
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Single-dose or single-use containers, which do not need preservatives [50, 54], and some multi-dose [64], preservative-free ophthalmic solutions are now available thanks to innovative device design, making it possible for patient preferences to be considered.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0153
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In our experience, some patients may prefer single-dose presentations, as they find them more convenient, however a multi-dose presentation has the benefit of reducing product waste, common in single-dose eye drops.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0154
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: In addition, patients requiring permanent or longterm topical eye treatment, namely glaucoma, have better treatment compliance with multi-dose delivery systems [65, 66], and this may be applicable to AC.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0155
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Several single-dose eye drop formulations are available for allergic conjunctivitis [50, 54], in addition to the usual BAK-containing multidose solutions, and a new preservative-free multi-dose formulation of bilastine with sodium hyaluronate has been recently approved [64].Along with the dispensation format, approaches to improving treatment adherence include treatment tolerability [67] and dosing schedules, as complex drug dosing regimens have been cited as a significant barrier to patient compliance [68, 69].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0156
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Simplifying dosing can be achieved by prescribing treatments that require once- or twice-daily dosing rather than multiple daily doses [69].
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0157
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Once-daily ophthalmic medications are now available for allergic conjunctivitis [31, 37, 38], and this could foster adherence and treatment compliance.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0158
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
## Key Messages: Implications for Clinical Practice

After reviewing the present situation of AC and its management with topical treatments, we can summarize some takehome messages for the practitioner:

- • Allergic conjunctivitis is prevalent and often underdiagnosed.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0159
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: A multidisciplinary approach may be of use in patients presenting with compatible symptoms and other frequent concomitant conditions, as correct diagnosis is key for initiating appropriate treatment.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0160
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: - • Management includes environmental, non-pharmacological, and pharmacological measures.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0161
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: The first step is to avoid allergen exposure, underlining the importance of performing an allergy study.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0162
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: - • Topical ophthalmic antihistamines or double-action drugs are first-line pharmacological treatment.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0163
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: They are all effective, but formulations, presentations, and dosing may influence the outcomes.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0164
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text:
- • Preservatives in the formulation of ophthalmic solutions induce ocular surface damage and exacerbate SAC and PAC and may lead to other medical conditions such as


- DED.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0165
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: Therefore, the use of preservative-free ophthalmic solutions is advisable.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0166
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: - • Co-formulation with hyaluronic acid has potential benefits, as it has been shown to improve ocular surface wound healing and to prevent dryness, therefore protecting the ocular surface.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0167
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: It has also been shown to increase the ocular bioavailability of active drugs.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0168
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: - • Dosing is important when speaking of treatment compliance: studies indicate that the easier the dosing, the higher the adherence.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0169
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: - • Anti-allergic ophthalmic topical treatments are available in single-dose or single-use presentations, which do not need preservatives, and in multi-dose devices, preferably without preservatives.
chunks.chunk_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions_chunk_0170
chunks.doc_id: PAPER - Leonardi et al. - 2024 - Allergic Conjunctivitis Management Update on Ophthalmic Solutions

chunks.text: - • An innovative multi-dose, preservative-free, antihistamine formulation (with HA) for once-daily treatment of allergic conjunctivitis has been recently developed.
